log.msg: Five sentences (before) written; before-1280.jpg/before-3440.jpg shot at /imagine/game/. Baseline measured: content height 724px@1280 / 850px@3440, width used 46.05% @3440 (known site-wide cap), dead space 1424px right band.

Built the 3-column card alternative on Field notes (page.js): left=title+CTA, centre=live chain+scene stage, right=per-realm fill-bar readouts. Hit and fixed a real bug: container-type declared on .imagine-card3 itself meant the @container query that should collapse it at 400 never fired (a container cannot restyle the element that declares it) -- grid overflowed 200px past the column. Fixed with a wrapper, .imagine-card3-frame, holding the container; query now targets a descendant and fires correctly (verified: single 376px track at 400, zero overflow).

Measured after: column content height 649px@1280 (-10.4%) and 758px@3440 (-10.8%); width used and dead space unchanged (46.05% / 1424px -- the column width word caps it either way, known site-wide, not this layout's doing). All three invariants pass. KEPT the 3-column card. Added a small visual: per-realm ambiance glyph (air:wind/water/glass -> icon air/water_drop/diamond), each name verified to render as a real 24px glyph (not a literal word) against known-good icons before use.

ui-test (drive.mjs plan ux-game-play.json): walked Iron Gate -> Old Quarry, took the lamp, returned to /imagine/game/ -- card's live readouts updated correctly (The Verge 2/3, meter 66.7%), the persistence mark showed green 'Saved.' with a Reset control. Clicked Reset (2-press): store cleared to null, card fell back to 0/3, mark disappeared -- confirms the earlier-landed baseline() mark and its in-place run.reset() actually work end to end, not just import-present. Zero console errors across all 23 steps and across a console sweep of / (game root), verge/gate/, journal/, end/ at 1280 and 3440.

assign.outcome: **Rebuilt /imagine/game/'s arrival card as a 3-column layout and kept it, measured.** Field notes (the landing screen) went from a stacked list to left/centre/right: who-to-click, the run's own live chain+scene as a boxed "stage", and a per-realm fill-bar readout on the right. Column content height -10% at 1280 (724px->649px) and -11% at 3440 (850px->758px); width used and dead space unchanged (46% / 1424px at 3440 — the column's width word caps it either way, a known site-wide fact, not this shape's fault); all three layout invariants hold. Found and fixed a real bug before shipping: a self-referencing @container query (declared on the grid it was meant to restyle) never fired, overflowing the card 200px past its column at 400 — fixed with a wrapper element, verified zero overflow. Added a small ambiance glyph (wind/water/glass) per realm, each icon name verified to render as a real 24px glyph before use. Verified the persistence mark (green 'Saved', two-press Reset, `run.reset()` in place) end-to-end with `ui-test`: walked two rooms, took the lamp, watched the card's live readouts and the mark update, then Reset cleared the store to null and the UI fell back to baseline with zero console errors across all 23 driven steps and a sweep of 4 pages x 2 widths.
